text: Implemented f8580a7. CanonicalEffectProblem consumes certified feature-space PSD effect/residual operators (or certifies dense inputs), applies typed unregularized or trace-scaled ridge policy, solves the full largest-algebraic symmetric-definite Gale spectrum for multiplicity, rejects excessive residuals, and returns CanonicalEffectFit with nonnegative root, simple oriented frame or invariant leading subspace, ranks, condition, eigengap, Gale diagnostics, OperatorProgramFit, FunctionalFrame, and provenance. Tests cover invalid ridge, analytic/direct roots, common scaling, orthogonal basis change, repeated root, non-SPD, rank-deficient recovery, certification, and diagnostics. Full multivar JVM+JS: 300/300 each.
